landing_page.hero: Relative container with soft mesh gradient background. Central content aligned. Floating 3D/glass cards showing 'Royalty Simulation' or 'Music Artwork' orbiting the text.
landing_page.benefits: Bento-box grid mode. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Mixing span-2 and span-1 cards. All cards are glass_card.
landing_page.how_it_works: Vertical timeline with large numbers (tracking-tighter) and connecting dashed lines. Side-alternating on desktop.
landing_page.pricing: Two columns. Glass cards. Recommended tier has a glowing 1px border. Switch toggle for Pay-Per-Release vs Annual.
landing_page.royalty_simulator: Floating glass card overlapping sections, with large sliders and big tabular numbers for IDR output.
landing_page.faq: Accordion list. Very clean, bottom borders only, no bounding boxes.

label_dashboard.layout: Mobile-first. Bottom nav bar on mobile (fixed, glassmorphism), slim sidebar on desktop.
label_dashboard.dashboard_home: Grid of solid_cards. Top row: large number metric cards (Saldo, Revenue). Charts below. Recent releases table at bottom.
label_dashboard.upload_release: Multi-step form wizard (glass_card on desktop, full-width on mobile). Metadata inputs, tracklist with drag-and-drop, artwork upload zone with image preview.

admin_dashboard.layout: Desktop-first. Fixed left sidebar (dark or light solid, not glass for readability). Top bar for global search and user profile.
admin_dashboard.data_views: Maximized screen width. Use solid_cards for tables. Strict grid alignments for heavy data tables with pagination, search, and bulk actions.

motion.hover: Subtle translate-y-1, shadow increase, duration-300 ease-out.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for hero elements and list items. (framer-motion).
motion.glass_shine: A fast moving gradient mask across the border on hover for premium tiers.

image_urls.description: Person playing acoustic guitars in a studio. Use as a masked or floating background element.
Computer desk with monitors. Use to contextualize the dashboard mockups.
Black vinyl record on orange surface. Cut out the record and float it in the hero section.
Live concert crowd. Use with heavy blur and overlay for the testimonials section background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML+Tailwind for the landing page to achieve the overlapping floating glass cards. Do not restrict yourself to Shadcn's rigid Card structures there.

For the Label and Admin dashboards, use Shadcn UI but aggressively override the border-radius to 24px and remove the default gray borders in favor of lighter slate-100 borders to maintain the Apple-like clean feel.
Apply data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows) using kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='submit-release-button').
Font setup: Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for headings and 'Manrope' for body. You MUST add these via Google Fonts.
The Hero section must feature the headline 'Distribusi Musik Lebih Rapi, Royalti Lebih Transparan.' with floating mockups or glass elements overlapping it.
Ensure the floating pill navbar uses backdrop-blur-2xl and bg-white/70.
